company.name: WorkClout
company.shortDescription: WorkClout is a SaaS company that helps manufacturers increase their operational efficiency.
company.description:
WorkClout is building the future of manufacturing.

WorkClout is a SaaS company that helps manufacturers increase their operational efficiency. WorkClout tracks every action on the factory floor and uses the data to make suggestions on how to increase efficiency.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based quality management system designed for manufacturers to digitize and streamline quality processes, inspections, and compliance.
productsAndServices.name: WorkClout Quality Management System (QMS)

productsAndServices.description: A no-code form builder allowing users to create and configure custom inspection and quality forms with over 20 field types and conditional logic.
productsAndServices.name: Custom Form Builder

productsAndServices.description: A task management tool integrated with WorkClout to track, assign, and automate corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) within quality workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Task Management for CAPA Processes

productsAndServices.description: A reporting module that provides customizable dashboards, PDF exports, and traceability reports to analyze quality data and inspection results.
productsAndServices.name: Reporting and Analytics

productsAndServices.description: Integration capabilities and public APIs that allow WorkClout to connect with external enterprise systems and cloud platforms for data synchronization.
productsAndServices.name: Integration and API Services

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $2,300,000, or 93.88% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,667,860 to $9,013,517, a 3.38x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 61 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 11 (-13).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Dirac, EtQ, AssurX.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
